result.note: Tests the destination of Operation Amistad, a named HADR airlift that is India's first such reach into Latin America.

questions.prompt: In June 2026, India sent two Indian Air Force C-17 aircraft under Operation Amistad to deliver earthquake relief to which country?
questions.explain: Operation Amistad was a military airlift of two C-17s to earthquake-hit Venezuela. It extends India's disaster-relief reach well beyond its usual Indian Ocean neighbourhood.
questions.source: India sent two air force C-17s to earthquake-hit Venezuela under Operation Amistad
